data.title: 木更 · 学校日常
data.description: 明亮的高中走廊里，换上标准百褶裙校服的木更在下课的人流中俏皮转身，双手背在身后向你投来温柔甜美的微笑——「在学校里我可是完美的高中生后辈哦。修，今天放学后的打工，我也要和你在一起！」
data.promptProse: She turns toward the viewer with both hands behind her back and a playful smile in the sunlit corridor. Other students pass farther down the corridor behind her.
data.animaCaption: She turns toward the viewer with her hands behind her back.
